scope: Bounded source/header/official Citro3D review; stopped when stationary area0 rendered textured walls.

findings.finding: No global VBO defect established. Parent observed current area0 textured walls, proving buffered terrain can render in this build.
findings.evidence: Root emulator test update; screenshot capture owned by root.

findings.finding: UV terrain attribute permutation is consistent: loaders id0→v0 (float3), fixed id1→v1, loader id2→v2 (float2); BufInfo permutation0x20 supplies ids0 and2 at20-byte stride.
findings.evidence: main.cpp configure_terrain_attributes_uv; installed c3d/attribs.h and buffers.h; official Citro3D v1.7.1 attribs.c/buffers.c.

findings.finding: An absent explicit VBO flush does not establish a defect: current main calls C3D_FrameEnd(0), whose official implementation flushes the entire linear heap before queue execution.
findings.evidence: main.cpp C3D_FrameEnd(0); Citro3D v1.7.1 renderqueue.c lines199-205.

findings.finding: Legacy0143 uses one float3 loader plus fixedcolor and BufInfo permutation0; enhancedUV uses separate layout and shader. Both apply same world scale1/512 and invert Y.
findings.evidence: main.cpp world_vertex_0143/world_vertex_uv and attribute setup; vshader0143 and vshader_uv.

findings.finding: Camera is inherited generic player-following LookAt/PerspTilt, not recovered retail camera. Area4 absence at diagnostic spawn does not prove geometry absent or attributefailure. Negative/special geometry paths and diagnosticspawn/camera must remain unverified.
findings.evidence: main.cpp lines1112-1116 uses eye offset5.2, height3 andtargetheight1.1; parent area4/area0 observations.
